besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb (reen spoel / die wind waai).
besluite.rede: Punctuation fix per AWS 2017; the protected wording 'spoel reen die kaal grond weg' stays intact.

besluite.fout: 'maak' is the wrong verb: toilets and showers do not make water, it runs out of them.
besluite.rede: The right verb replaces a loose 'maak' without moving the meaning, and it matches the glossary's 'wegloop'.

besluite.fout: 'stroomaf' at the end of the list reads as if it belongs only to 'diere'.
besluite.rede: Placing 'stroomaf' after 'die water' attaches it to the water and removes the stumble, with the same meaning.
